parameters.name: DatasetMaxBindCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of bindings for each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxEntityCount
parameters.description:
The maximum number of metadata entities in each dataset.
>This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxFileCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of files in each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxRelationCount
parameters.description:
The maximum number of metadata relationships in each dataset.
>This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxTotalFileSize
parameters.description: The maximum total file size in each dataset. After the limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. Unit: bytes.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The project description. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: ProjectMaxDatasetCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of datasets in the project. Valid values: 1 to 1000000000.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: ServiceRole
parameters.description:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources such as Object Storage Service (OSS).

To customize a service role, create a regular service role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console and grant permissions to the role. For more information, see [Create a regular service role](~~116800~~) and [Grant permissions to a role](~~116147~~).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The workflow template ID. For more information, see [Workflow templates and operators](~~466304~~).
